title: Determining Gender Differences in Education and Labor Market Outcomes
title_zh: 确定教育与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异
abstract: This paper studies gender differences in educational attainment and labor market outcomes. Across 21 OECD countries, though men are paid more than women, the college attainment rates and college premia are (mostly) higher for women. This paper explains these patterns through the quantitative analysis of a dynamic choice model of education and labor market outcomes. Using the estimated model, we decompose the observed gender gaps through a series of counterfactual exercises. One finding is that these gaps are driven mainly by gender differences in the average compensation at non-college jobs. The estimated lower compensation for non-college women generates for them larger college premia and higher incentives to attend college relative to men. A second finding, through the lens of the estimated model, is that observed gender wage gaps for college workers are largely driven by differences in the gender specific distributions across signals of ability rather than wage differences across genders given a signal.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了教育成就与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异。在21个OECD国家中，尽管男性薪酬高于女性，但女性的大学入学率及大学教育溢价（大多）更高。本文通过构建教育与劳动力市场结果的动态选择模型并进行量化分析，解释了上述模式。基于估计模型，我们通过一系列反事实模拟分解了观察到的性别差距。研究发现之一：这些差距主要由非大学职业中男女平均薪酬差异驱动。非大学职业女性薪酬较低，导致其大学教育溢价更高，且相较于男性更倾向于接受高等教育。研究发现之二：通过估计模型的视角，大学劳动者的性别工资差距主要源于不同能力信号在性别分布上的差异，而非给定信号下性别间的工资差异。

title: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
title_zh: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因
authors: Francisco Arroyo Marioli, Carlos A. Vegh
abstract: A large literature has documented that fiscal policy is procyclical in emerging markets/developing countries and acyclical/countercyclical in advanced economies. This paper analyzes fiscal procyclicality in commodity-exporting countries. The paper makes two novel contributions. First, based on the “when it rains, it pours” phenomenon (that is, contractionary fiscal policy amplifies the business cycle), the paper shows that, on average, government spending magnifies the business cycle by 21 percent of the initial drop in output following a fall in commodity prices. Second, the paper estimates the welfare costs of fiscal procyclicality at 36 percent of the commodity business cycle. (JEL E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02)
abstract_zh: 大量文献表明，财政政策在新兴市场/发展中国家呈现顺周期性，而在发达经济体中则为非周期性/逆周期性。本文分析了大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性，并做出两项创新性贡献。首先，基于"祸不单行"现象（即紧缩性财政政策放大经济周期），本文证明：在大宗商品价格下跌后，政府支出平均会使初始产出下降的幅度放大21%。其次，本文估算出财政顺周期性的福利成本相当于大宗商品经济周期的36%。（JEL分类号：E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02）

title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维
abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a $$\phi $$ ϕ -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson $$\chi ^2$$ χ 2 distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的一厢情愿思维模型，该模型既捕捉了乐观偏差信念的收益与成本，也刻画了由此引发的行为。基于Bratcha和Brown（2012）以及Caplin和Leahy（2019）的研究，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于$$\phi $$-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson $$\chi ^2$$距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将一厢情愿行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，以捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了一厢情愿思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。

title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治
abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。

title: Is the iPhone Birth Control? Causal Evidence from AT&T’s 2007–2011 Carrier Monopoly
title_zh: iPhone是避孕工具吗？来自AT&T 2007–2011年运营商垄断的因果证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降趋势难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究的结果表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而较高年龄段虽呈现统计显著但降幅较小。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了高龄女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用与性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。

title: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
title_zh: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响
abstract: Using staggered state‐level changes in noncompete enforceability, we document that reduced enforcement increases profitability, valuation, productivity, and plant‐level growth in knowledge‐worker‐intensive firms relative to other firms. Critically, these gains are concentrated among the most productive knowledge‐worker firms, consistent with an assortative matching mechanism in which top firms attract the most productive workers when noncompetes no longer bind. Using inventor‐level data, we find direct evidence of this sorting: more productive inventors migrate toward more productive firms following reductions in enforceability. Consequently, performance dispersion widens across knowledge‐worker‐intensive industries, as the most productive firms pull further ahead of their less productive peers.
abstract_zh: 利用各州对竞业限制可执行性的交错调整，我们研究发现：相较于其他企业，降低竞业限制执行力度会提升知识密集型企业的盈利能力、估值、生产率及工厂层面的增长。关键的是，这些收益集中在最具生产力的知识密集型企业中，这与"分类匹配机制"的推论一致——当竞业限制不再具有约束力时，顶尖企业能够吸引最具生产力的劳动者。基于发明者层面的数据，我们发现了这种分类效应的直接证据：在竞业限制执行力度降低后，更具生产力的发明者会向更具生产力的企业迁移。由此，知识密集型行业内的绩效差距持续扩大，最具生产力的企业进一步拉开与低效同行的差距。

title: Work orientations and turnover
abstract: Voluntary turnover imposes substantial costs on organizations, yet we know little about whether workers’ fundamental orientations toward work shape their mobility decisions. In this paper, we distinguish between job, career, and calling orientations, defined as the long-term beliefs about the role of work in one’s life. Using original survey data from the Dutch LISS panel, we show that work orientations are strong predictors of quit intentions and on-the-job search, even after controlling for socio-demographic characteristics, personality traits, job characteristics, and job satisfaction. Career-oriented individuals exhibit significantly higher quit intentions and search activity, particularly when perceived promotion opportunities are limited. Calling-oriented individuals report substantially lower quit intentions and on-the-job search. By contrast, having a job orientation is not systematically associated with turnover-related outcomes. The associations between work orientations and actual job quits one and two years later are weaker, suggesting that work orientations primarily shape turnover intentions and preparatory search behavior, while actual working conditions more strongly influence mobility. Overall, our findings identify work orientations as a novel and quantitatively important determinant of turnover-related behavior and highlight the role of workers’ underlying motivations in shaping mobility beyond standard economic predictors.
abstract_zh: 自愿离职给组织带来巨大成本，然而我们对工作者对工作的基本取向是否影响其流动决策知之甚少。本文区分了工作取向、职业取向和使命取向，这些取向被定义为关于工作在生活中角色的长期信念。利用荷兰LISS面板的原始调查数据，我们发现即使在控制社会人口特征、人格特质、工作特征和工作满意度后，工作取向仍是离职意向和在职求职的强预测因子。职业取向个体表现出显著更高的离职意向和求职活动，尤其在感知晋升机会有限时。使命取向个体报告的离职意向和在职求职显著较低。相比之下，工作取向与离职相关结果并无系统性关联。工作取向与一年及两年后实际离职的关联较弱，表明工作取向主要塑造离职意向和预备性求职行为，而实际工作条件对流动性的影响更强。总体而言，我们的研究将工作取向识别为离职相关行为的新颖且数量上重要的决定因素，并强调工作者潜在动机在标准经济预测因子之外对流动性塑造的作用。

title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究
authors: Tinna Laufey Ásgeirsdóttir, Viktor Andri Kárason
abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
abstract_zh: 2018年，两项基于澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动动态调查的补偿性收入变化研究，报告了截然不同的货币化健康价值：完全质量调整生命年（QALY）增益为42,000–67,000澳元，而0.10 QALY损失则为162,000澳元（在线性缩放下相当于每QALY 160万澳元）。我们展开计量经济学侦探工作，以识别这些差异的来源，仔细对齐样本、交叉检验方法论，并揭示导致结果分歧的方法论差异。得失框架是最大的差异来源（与意愿接受/意愿支付证据一致），而估计量选择（工具变量与简化形式）及收入等值化进一步放大了差异，共同导致了数量级上的差距，其影响超越了健康领域。

title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs
authors: Mohammed Abdellaoui, Philippe Colo, Brian Hill
abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。

title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
title_zh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响
authors: JIANGZE BIAN, ZHI DA, ZHIGUO HE, DONG LOU, KELLY SHUE, HAO ZHOU
abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
abstract_zh: 利用涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和未受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的颗粒化数据，我们提供了关于散户投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。首先，我们证明散户投资者在股票交易中尽管面临高昂的借贷成本仍选择加杠杆的行为，与其博彩偏好相关。其次，我们揭示保证金借贷会影响投资者的交易行为——当投资者接近追加保证金通知时，更倾向于抛售持仓。最后，我们证明由保证金驱动的交易会聚合影响资产价格，并加剧股票间的冲击溢出效应（例如，从博彩类股票向非博彩类股票传导）。
